description: Report one monitor's uptime percentage, average response time and incident count over the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days at once, to answer how reliable it has been. For a day-by-day series use get_uptime_daily; for response time per region use get_response_time_by_region; for the individual failures use list_check_results. Returns monitor_id and windows keyed 24h, 7d and 30d, each with uptime_percentage (DEGRADED checks count as up; null when there were no checks), total_checks, up_checks, down_checks, degraded_checks, incident_count and avg_response_time_ms.

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: get_uptime_summary
title: Get uptime for a monitor
